text:
Maya: Quick capture from HelixCare onboarding call just now — they had 3 main asks and a couple of pain quotes. Pulling into thread so PMs + eng can triage.
Maya: TL;DR — customer wants: (1) per-route usage breakdown in the Console exports, (2) clearer token-cost estimates per-example, (3) a retry/backoff UI for failed dedicated requests.
Maya: Direct customer quotes: "We have no visibility into which endpoints spike cost each day," and "when a burst fails we end up blindly re-running and overspending."
Riya: thanks for the capture — can you paste the call snippet or transcript? also is this a pilot or paying prod account?
Maya: paste below — transcript excerpt + call notes. Pilot -> converting next quarter, currently on trial with ~30 devs and 2 prod integrations. renewal flag: medium risk if we don't show cost clarity.
Maya: ---
HelixCare notes:
- 00:12 Customer: running evaluation workloads across 4 routes, 2 of which use embeddings heavily.
- 00:18 They saw daily spend variance 3x between dev and staging with same traffic pattern.
- 00:45 Asked for Console CSV that breaks down cost by route + model version.
- 01:20 Mentioned failures during nightly batch sends; want visible retry/backoff metrics and per-request status in UI.
- 02:05 Asked for a quick formula in Console: given tokens per-example and sample batch size, show estimated daily cost.
---
Maya: Suggested tags: feature:console-cost-breakdown, feature:retry-visibility, ux:cost-estimator
Ethan: Thanks Maya — quick q: how many customers have asked for route-level cost exports recently? we should know if this is a single-customer ask or a pattern.
Riya: I logged three other customers this quarter asking for per-route billing (ParkCo + NorthBay + Brightlane). Not identical asks but overlapping.
Ethan: ok that's a pattern. can you also add whether HelixCare uses dedicated or hosted? affects implementation approach.
Maya: they're on hosted API for now; evaluating Dedicated for throughput later.
Sam: from an eng perspective: route-level CSV + cost formula is straightforward if we hook into existing per-token counters. retry visibility requires request-level statuses stored for 7 days — do we have that telemetry?
Sam: also need repro steps for the failure pattern — are they seeing 5xx from runtime or client-side timeouts?
Maya: they saw 502s during spikes (runtime). I captured their sample payload and we reproduced a similar pattern in staging when firing concurrent batches. repro steps:
1) Use route `helixcare-ingest` with model `open-ggml-13b`
2) fire 6 concurrent batch requests of 200 items each
3) observe timeouts around the 60s mark and occasional 502s in runtime logs
Maya: sample payload link (internal): <https://drive.redwood/helixcare/sample-batch.json>
Ethan: sounds actionable. Proposed triage: label cost-breakdown as P2 (customer-impact but not urgent), retry-visibility as P1 for HelixCare (renewal risk). Any objections?
Riya: agree with P1 on retry-visibility for HelixCare specifically. P2 for cost breakdown but recommend we include cost estimator in upcoming onboarding playbook.
Sam: agree. I can prototype a CSV export endpoint + small Console UI row this sprint if PMs OK. retry-visibility needs storage + UI work so will need a small cross-team spike.
product-bot: New ticket created: RNWD-1420 "Console: per-route cost export (CSV)" assigned -> eng-triage. Link: https://tickets.redwood/RNWD-1420 :eyes:
Maya: leaving next steps: (1) Ethan, please confirm prioritization and move to triage; (2) Sam, drop estimated T-shirt size / spike time in ticket; (3) Riya + I will add HelixCare quotes to the ticket and flag renewal timeline.
Ethan: I'll move both items into the product triage board and tag them with customer-impact and renewal-risk. can we sync 15m tomorrow 11:15 to align on scope?
Riya: 11:15 works for me.
Sam: fine. I'll post a short spike plan in the ticket before EOD.
Maya: thanks all — adding :thumbsup: from HelixCare that they'd prefer the CSV and retry UI as a bundle if possible.
Riya: capturing follow-up actions in Asana as well -> assignees: Maya (CS notes), Riya (customer follow-up), Ethan (prioritization), Sam (eng spike).
Maya: will do.
product-bot: Reminder: please add a short acceptance criteria in the ticket (customer can export 30-day route cost CSV; Console shows per-request retry/failure status for 7 days).
Maya: noted and added those ACs.
Ethan: cool — thanks Maya. moving to triage now. :rocket:
